Quire signatures are marked in the middle of a bottom margin of the first page of a quire. Quires of 8 ff. with the exception of quires IV, X, XXI and XXII which are of 10 ff.
Repair on parchment by a more recent Melkite hand: ff. 233-237.

Two wooden binding boards covered with leather. Pastedowns from Syriac parchment codex attached to the boards.
